evals.name: tailors-and-fits-two-pages
evals.prompt:
[Eval fixture mode: the inventory is `evals/tailored-resume-builder/fixtures/Eric-Full-Resume.md`. Use it as Eric-Full-Resume.md. Use the real Job-Seeker-6 template if available. Do not use the network. Save outputs to outputs/.]

Build me a tailored resume for the job in `evals/tailored-resume-builder/fixtures/jd-cloud-migration.txt`.
evals.expected_output: A 2-page resume in the template layout led by cloud migration and vendor management, saved with the JD in a company-named folder.
expectations: Competencies and career highlights lead with cloud migration and vendor management
Every bullet, highlight and competency traces to a line in the fixture inventory; no new numbers, tools or employers
Employer, titles and dates match the inventory exactly
build_resume.py reports exactly 2 pages (or the run says it could not verify)
The .docx, .pdf and _JD.txt are saved together in a folder named for the company (Acme_Widgets), named Eric_Scott_Resume_<Company>_<Role>...
No text from the template's sample content (Liberty Global, Wharton, etc.) appears in the output
Ends with a gaps list of required JD items the inventory doesn't support

evals.name: no-jd-no-resume
evals.prompt: Make me a resume for a Senior Engineer role at Acme. I don't have the job description handy.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the job description or a tracker row; builds nothing.
expectations: Asks for the job description (or a tracker row or URL) before doing any tailoring

evals.name: does-not-invent-missing-requirements
evals.prompt:
[Eric-Full-Resume.md is `evals/tailored-resume-builder/fixtures/Eric-Full-Resume.md`. Save outputs to outputs/.]

Tailor my resume to `evals/tailored-resume-builder/fixtures/jd-unsupported-requirements.txt`.
evals.expected_output: A resume that features vendor management and omits Kubernetes certification and Rust, with both listed as gaps.
expectations: Neither 'Kubernetes', 'CKA' nor 'Rust' appears anywhere in the resume
The gaps list names the Kubernetes certification and the 10+ years of Rust as unsupported

evals.name: inventory-missing-stops
evals.prompt:
[The folder contains only Eric_Scott_Resume-Big2.docx and the template; there is no Eric-Full-Resume.md.]

Build a tailored resume for `evals/tailored-resume-builder/fixtures/jd-cloud-migration.txt`.
evals.expected_output: Stops and reports the inventory wasn't found.
expectations: Reports that Eric-Full-Resume.md was not found
Does not fall back to the Big2 .docx or to memory, and produces no resume
